name: gate_topk
description: Top-k over the last dimension of a 2-D tensor x of shape [M,N]. Returns the k largest values per row in descending order and their int32 column indices; values preserve x.dtype and indices are newly allocated int32. Ties are broken toward the smaller column index. The Triton kernel requires the last dimension to be contiguous and 1 <= k <= N. Current tests exercise float32 inputs with k in {1,4,8,32} and N in {64,128,256,384}; inputs are read-only.
